commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+4' We are about to witness a subsitution. Bojan Miovski (Girona) for Viktor Tsygankov.
90+2' The resulting corner from Carles Perez (Getafe) comes to nothing.

90+1' Paulo Gazzaniga was forced into action to thwart Carles Perez (Getafe). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot towards the roof of the net but couldn't beat the keeper.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar Alderete (Getafe) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) replaces Ramon Terrats.
90' Substitution. Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) on for Christantus Uche.
89' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is adjudged offside.
88' Christantus Uche (Getafe) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
87' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
86' Djene (Getafe) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.

84' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but David Soria thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
83' The ratio of the ball possession is 69:31.
81' Arthur Melo (Girona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
80' A goal, which was scored by Christantus Uche (Getafe), was disallowed due to offside.
79' The referee gives a yellow card to Portu (Girona) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Portu (Girona) is replacing Cristhian Stuani.
78' Michel prepares a substitution. Bryan Gil is replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
77' Substitution. Allan Nyom (Getafe) in, Mauro Arambarri out.
76' Carles Perez (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
73' RED card! Yangel Herrera (Girona) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

72' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Yangel Herrera (Girona), but referee Alejandro Quintero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
71' The attendance for today's match is 10354.
69' Michel decides to make a substitution. David Lopez will be replaced by Arthur Melo (Girona).
69' It will be a substitution. Yaser Asprilla (Girona) is ready to enter the pitch as Oriol Romeu walks off.
66' Getafe will take a corner kick.
65' 12:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
62' 1 - 2 Goal 1:2! Borja Mayoral (Getafe) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
62' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanmi departs the field of play to be replaced by Borja Mayoral (Getafe).
61' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carles Perez (Getafe) replacing Juan Bernat.
60' What a save from David Soria! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
59' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
57' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
56' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
55' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
54' 1 - 1 The score has changed – 1:1. Viktor Tsygankov sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Yangel Herrera (Girona) jumps highest and plants a header inside the right post.
54' The referee awards a corner and Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) goes over to take it.
54' The game is interrupted now, Ramon Terrats (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
49' A rebound sits up perfectly for David Lopez (Girona), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
49' Girona keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
47' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Juanmi (Getafe) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Paulo Gazzaniga easily catches the ball.
46' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle. Daley Blind (Girona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
43' A poorly taken free kick by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
41' Alejandro Quintero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Djene (Getafe) and blew his whistle.
39' Juanmi (Getafe) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
36' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle as Yangel Herrera (Girona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
35' Diego Rico (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Quintero no option but to blow his whistle.
33' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
33' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
33' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
31' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
30' The free kick is taken by Miguel Gutierrez (Girona), but ball is cleared.
29' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
28' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
27' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
25' Total attempts – 2:4.
22' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
21' Djene (Getafe) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
19' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
19' The linesman raises his flag. Yangel Herrera (Girona) is adjudged offside.
18' Juanmi (Getafe) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) will take the corner.
15' Bryan Gil (Girona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

13' Christantus Uche (Getafe) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
12' Rough tackle by Daley Blind (Girona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Arnau Martinez (Girona) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
8' Yangel Herrera (Girona) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Quintero stops the game and makes a call.
6' Girona are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
3' 0 - 1 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Christantus Uche (Getafe), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:1.
2' Yangel Herrera (Girona) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by David Soria stops the ball from going inside right post.
1' Christantus Uche (Getafe) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero is the one to supervise the game today.
